history.summary: A 517 sqft 1BR at $1,972 psf, 220m from Eunos MRT, in a 1,399-unit MCL Land development with a deep 474-transaction history. Strong location and liquidity offset a modest 2.49% resale-only appreciation and the inherent 1BR niche.
history.rating_rationale: EW7 Eunos at 220m is the best transit in the batch, and 474 URA txns (resale-only CAGR 2.49% on a huge series, very reliable) give exceptional liquidity for a 1BR. Asking $1,972 psf is ~14% below the $2,294 project median — real value. D14 Paya Lebar Central / airbase-relocation catalyst supports the medium term. Held to Buy not Strong Buy by sub-baseline 2.49% appreciation and the 1BR investor-segment competition typical of large D14 launches.
red_flags: Resale-only appreciation 2.49%/yr is below the RCR ~5.8% prior
1BR in a 1,399-unit mega-development means heavy internal rental/resale competition
$1.02M crosses into the higher 1BR price band, trimming the buyer pool
catalysts: EW7 Eunos MRT 220m — top-tier transit, prime rental driver
~14% below project median PSF gives margin of safety
D14 Paya Lebar Central commercial growth and airbase relocation

history.summary: 99yr 2022 1BR, 2-min walk to Eunos MRT (D14, RCR). Verified genuinely cheap: recent 1BR resales transacted $2,205 PSF (Dec-2025, 527sqft) and $2,417 PSF (Jan-2026, 581sqft) vs this $1,973 PSF asking, i.e. ~12-18% below comparable recent transactions. Deep, trustworthy data (474 appreciation txns, 46-unit cohort).
history.rating_rationale: This is the strongest of the five. The algo's -10.7% cohort cheapness is corroborated by web transactions: two recent 1BR sales at $2,205 and $2,417 PSF make the $1,973 PSF asking a clear discount to verified comparables, not a data quirk. The signal rests on a deep 46-transaction cohort and 474 appreciation transactions, so confidence is high. Eunos MRT 2-min and a large 1,399-unit project give excellent rental and exit liquidity (54 sales / 138 rental txns recently). RCR forward prior (~+3.5%) is favourable. The only modest concern is a high absolute PSF for a small 517sqft unit, but it is cheap relative to its own size band.
red_flags: High absolute PSF (~$1,973) typical of a small 517 sqft unit — quantum is reasonable but PSF-sensitive buyers should note
99yr leasehold so age decay applies, though only 4 years old
catalysts: 2-minute walk to Eunos MRT (East-West Line) underpins durable rental demand
Large 1,399-unit project = deep liquidity for both rental and exit
Verified ~12-18% discount to recent 1BR transactions provides immediate value cushion
